Tutorials[]

Equipment[]

In Currency Wars, you can equip up to 3 pieces of Equipment on each Character.
Equipping suitable gears on a character can significantly boost that character's combat ability.
In Currency Wars, you can equip up to 3 pieces of Equipment on each Character.
Equipping suitable gears on a character can significantly boost that character's combat ability.

Equipment: Basic Equipment[]

Basic equipment is the most fundamental type of equipment, providing different Base Stat bonuses for the Character.
Basic equipment is the most fundamental type of equipment, providing different Base Stat bonuses for the Character.

Equipment: Equipment Synthesis[]

Any two basic equipment can be synthesized into a piece of advanced equipment.
Click on the basic equipment to view the synthesis chart.
Any two basic equipment can be synthesized into a piece of advanced equipment.
Click on the basic equipment to view the synthesis chart.

Equipment: Advanced Equipment[]

Advanced equipment retains the Base Stats of the basic equipment from the synthesis table.
In addition, advanced equipment provides unique combat effects that can greatly enhance a character's combat capabilities.
Advanced equipment retains the Base Stats of the basic equipment from the synthesis table.
In addition, advanced equipment provides unique combat effects that can greatly enhance a character's combat capabilities.

Equipment: Recommendation and Tracking[]

You can view the recommended equipment suitable for a character on the Character Card.
You can view the recommended equipment suitable for a character on the Character Card.
Master the Equipment Tracking function to quickly find the recommended equipment for a character!

Rare Equipment: Privileged Equipment[]

The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.
The enhanced version of advanced equipment with the same name. In addition to having more powerful stats, its unique combat effects will also be strengthened.

Rare Equipment: Emblem[]

Generally, a Bond has a corresponding Bond Emblem equipment.
When the Emblem is equipped on a non-Bond character, that Character will join the Bond, adding to the Bond's count and simultaneously gaining the enhancement effect provided by the Bond.
Generally, a Bond has a corresponding Bond Emblem equipment.
When the Emblem is equipped on a non-Bond character, that Character will join the Bond, adding to the Bond's count and simultaneously gaining the enhancement effect provided by the Bond.
Usually, synthesizing Red Gems/Blue Gems with a piece of basic equipment results in Emblems of various Bonds.
Usually, synthesizing Red Gems/Blue Gems with a piece of basic equipment results in Emblems of various Bonds.

Rare Equipment: Red Gem and Blue Gem[]

Rare synthesis material, usable for:
Synthesizing various Bond Emblems to increase the number of members in a Bond.
Synthesizing Wealth Gems to increase the team size limit.
Rare synthesis material, usable for:
Synthesizing various Bond Emblems to increase the number of members in a Bond.
Synthesizing Wealth Gems to increase the team size limit.

Rare Equipment: Wealth Gem[]

A very rare and valuable piece of equipment. When acquired, it increases the team size limit by 1.
While continuously equipped, it also grants some Gold Coins.
A very rare and valuable piece of equipment. When acquired, it increases the team size limit by 1.
While continuously equipped, it also grants some Gold Coins.
Perform synthesis using any 2 Red Gems/Blue Gems to obtain a Wealth Gem.

Consumables: Disassembly Wrench[]

Use the Disassembly Wrench to freely reassign equipped gears and maximize your team's combat power.

Consumables: Smelting Furnace[]

Drag onto the equipment to randomly re-obtain another piece of equipment of the same quality.
Drag onto the equipment to randomly re-obtain another piece of equipment of the same quality.
Drag onto the character to randomly reroll all pieces of equipment on that character.

Consumables: Staff Projector[]

Drag onto the character to obtain a 1-star duplicate of that character.
Drag onto the character to obtain a 1-star duplicate of that character.

Consumables: Good Fortune Token[]

Drag onto the character to choose and obtain 1 of the 4 pieces of advanced equipment from that character's recommended equipment list.
Drag onto the character to choose and obtain 1 of the 4 pieces of advanced equipment from that character's recommended equipment list.

Consumables: Special Privilege Card[]

Drag onto a piece of advanced equipment to upgrade it, obtaining the privileged equipment of the same name, which greatly enhances the equipment's stat values and special effects.

Trash Bag[]

Trash Bags can occasionally be acquired from Aha when the Elation Bond is first set.

Otherwise, the affix "Treasure to Trash" is required, which has a 50% chance of the first synthesized piece of advanced equipment turning into it instead.

The Golden Trash Bag can be acquired through two methods: a Special Privilege Card, which also grants the player 15 Gold Coins, or having 3 Trash Bags that are not being used by any character in the run. If three Golden Trash Bags are equipped on one character, the player will receive 333 Gold Coins.
